Line Cook
Saltgrass Kitchen & Bar
Nanaimo, BC
Pay: $18.50–$20.00 per hour
Job type: Full-time, Part-time
Shift and schedule: Evening shift, Weekends as needed

Full job description
Saltgrass Kitchen & Bar is a fictional 90-seat neighbourhood restaurant with a busy summer patio. We're looking for a Line Cook to join our kitchen team.

Responsibilities:
- Prepare and cook menu items to recipe and plating standards on the grill and sauté stations
- Set up and stock your station before service and break it down at close
- Follow food safety, labelling and FIFO rotation procedures
- Keep the line, walk-in cooler and dish area clean and organised
- Communicate with the sous chef and servers during busy service

Qualifications:
- Previous line cook experience in a high-volume kitchen
- Able to stand for long shifts and lift up to 23 kg
- Good knife skills and a positive attitude

Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Permanent

Pay: $18.50-$20.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30 – 40 per week

Benefits:
• Discounted or free food
• Extended health care
• Flexible schedule

Schedule:
• Evening shift
• Weekends as needed
• Holidays

Supplemental pay types:
• Tips

Experience:
• line cook: 1 year (preferred)
• kitchen: 1 year (required)

Licence/Certification:
• FOODSAFE Level 1 (required)

Work Location: In person

Application deadline: 2026-12-04
Expected start date: 2026-12-10
